title: Claude Code helped me hunt ScreenConnect abuse. Two signed clients were on the same host.
content_md:
I used Claude Code to help hunt two signed ScreenConnect clients on one lab host, with every result checked by hand. Video: https://youtu.be/JBEj3hSuWng Claude Code ran the provenance and signer queries across archived Defender telemetry in ADX (KQL) and Elastic (ES|QL). I checked the returned rows and investigated the relays and operator activity by hand. The operator used the first client to install the second, which called a server they controlled. Each had its own service. Both were validly signed by ConnectWise. The practical check: count the ScreenConnect services, then inspect which relay each one calls. Multiple instances need investigation and context; a valid signature alone did not distinguish these implants. The walkthrough shows the Claude Code steps, my manual checks, and bot
